explainer_content.short_definition: Country music built to cross the fence into pop radio and mass entertainment.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Country-pop has appeared in waves, from smooth crossover singers to 1990s blockbuster albums and younger artists moving between country and pop markets.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It expanded country audiences and showed how country songwriting could live inside pop-scale production.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The hook is polished and immediate, while twang, narrative, or country imagery remains legible.
what_to_listen_for: country lyric frame with pop lift
